summary: Scoped frontend retest of the two reported gallery bugs on the preview URL. BUG 1 (tiny gallery card) is FIXED: cards render 429x429 px (ratio 1.000) at 1400px viewport, filling their grid column; the no-cover/no-image fallback shows the green gradient + 'Photos coming soon' placeholder correctly. BUG 2 (lightbox arrows not working) is NOT FIXED: although the Lightbox is now correctly portaled to document.body (parentElement=BODY, closest('[role=dialog]')=null, z-index=9999), EVERY mouse interaction inside it is dead. Radix Dialog sets `pointer-events:none` on <body>, and the portaled lightbox inherits it (computed pointerEvents of the lightbox root, next button and image = 'none'). document.elementFromPoint at the center of [data-testid=lightbox-next] returns the Radix DialogOverlay, so clicks fall through to the overlay and close the whole Snapshots dialog instead of advancing the image. Keyboard nav works. A programmatic .click() on lightbox-next DID advance 1/2 -> 2/2, proving the handlers themselves are correct and the failure is purely pointer-events/dismissable-layer related.

ui_bugs.issue: BUG NOT FIXED: lightbox root inherits `pointer-events:none` from <body> (set by Radix Dialog while the Snapshots dialog is open). All mouse interactions are dead: next, prev, download, close, thumbnail strip and click-to-zoom all time out with the DialogOverlay intercepting pointer events. Fix: set pointerEvents:'auto' (inline style or pointer-events-auto) on the portaled lightbox root.

Secondary defect proven by runtime experiment: once pointer-events is re-enabled, a real click inside the lightbox is treated as an outside interaction by the Radix DismissableLayer and closes BOTH the lightbox and the parent Snapshots dialog. Fix: stop propagation of pointerdown/mousedown on the lightbox root (do NOT stop 'click' — React's delegated handler needs it), or on <DialogContent> add onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside guards that preventDefault when the event target is inside [data-testid=lightbox].

Escape closes the lightbox AND the parent Snapshots dialog at once (observed lightbox=0 and guest-gallery-dialog=0 after one Escape). Expected: Escape closes only the lightbox and leaves the thumbnail grid open. Fix: preventDefault/stopPropagation on the Escape keydown (or DialogContent onEscapeKeyDown) while lightboxIdx !== null.
Spec asked for 2x zoom on image click; implementation uses transform scale(1.5). Minor spec deviation (could not be exercised by a real click because of the pointer-events blocker).

integration_issues.issue: Unverifiable end-to-end because of the pointer-events blocker. Download handler could not be exercised by a real user click; a programmatic click showed the code path builds an <a> with download attr + data:image href, but real-user download remains UNVERIFIED.

action_items: Add pointerEvents:'auto' to the portaled lightbox root in /app/frontend/src/pages/Guest.jsx (Radix Dialog sets body{pointer-events:none}) — this is the real root cause, the portal move alone was not enough.

Prevent the Radix DismissableLayer from dismissing the Snapshots dialog on lightbox interaction: stopPropagation on pointerdown/mousedown only (never on click), or guard DialogContent onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside/onEscapeKeyDown when lightboxIdx !== null.
Make Escape close only the lightbox, not the parent dialog.
Optionally align zoom factor with spec (scale(2) instead of scale(1.5)).
critical_code_review_comments: Guest.jsx line ~894: createPortal(document.body) escapes the DOM nesting but not the inherited `pointer-events:none` Radix puts on <body>; any body-portaled UI rendered while a Radix modal is open must explicitly re-enable pointer-events AND opt out of the dismissable-layer outside-click/escape handling.

Consider decoupling the lightbox from the gallery Dialog entirely (e.g. close the Dialog when opening the lightbox, or render Dialog with modal={false}) to avoid the two layers fighting over pointer/keyboard events.
Guest.jsx is ~970 lines — the Lightbox component and the gallery section should be split into their own modules.

rca_of_the_issue: Radix UI Dialog (DismissableLayer + react-remove-scroll) applies `pointer-events:none` to <body> and `pointer-events:auto` only to the overlay/content while open. The lightbox is portaled to document.body, so it inherits pointer-events:none — hit-testing therefore lands on the DialogOverlay (z-50) despite the lightbox z-index of 9999, and clicks either do nothing or dismiss the dialog. Proof: computed pointerEvents = 'none' on lightbox/next/image; document.elementFromPoint(next-button center) returns the overlay div; programmatic element.click() advances the counter correctly. Runtime experiment: setting pointerEvents='auto' made the button hit-testable but the click was treated as an outside pointerdown and closed the Dialog; additionally stopping pointerdown propagation kept both layers open, confirming the two-part fix.
